name: eazydata
description: eazydata provider plugin for Magpie: an OpenAI-compatible relay (eazydata.org) whose model list is read live from /v1/models and whose dollar balance is read from the billing routes
author: zZ783

scripts.check: node --check index.mjs && node --check src/index.mjs && node test/all.mjs

summary.en: OpenAI-compatible relay on eazydata.org, with its model list read live from /v1/models and the account's dollar balance read from the relay's billing routes
summary.zh: eazydata.org 上的 OpenAI 兼容中转，模型列表实时读取 /v1/models，账户余额读取中转站的 billing 接口
